ar.title: Georgia Southern - Admission requirements for international students

dl.title: Georgia Southern - Application deadlines and requirements

faq.title: Georgia Southern - International students (overview and FAQ)

test_policy.notes: First-year applicants (including international) need a 2.5+ GPA and SAT or ACT scores meeting subscore minimums: SAT EBRW 480+ and Math 440+, or ACT English or Reading 17+ and Math 17+ (CLT is accepted domestically). College Navigator lists test-optional for fall 2024, but the current pages require scores. The University College pathway lists only a 2.0 GPA and transcript.

requirements.notes: Apply on Georgia Southern's own application or the Common App (first-year). $30 non-refundable fee (credit card). Official high school transcripts are mailed or emailed by a school official to intladmissions@georgiasouthern.edu, with a certified English translation if not in English; SAT/ACT scores must come from the testing agency. Essays and recommendations are not mentioned on the page.

deadlines.label: Priority international undergraduate admission (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: The international FAQ says priority admission for fall is typically the preceding April 1 (spring: Nov. 1). Dates print without a year; treated as fall 2027.

deadlines.label: Fall semester application deadline (general undergraduate)
deadlines.notes: General deadline for Fall full term; decisions depend on submitting all documents at least one week before classes. An I-20 and visa take time, so apply well before this date.

deadlines.label: International Merit Scholarship priority deadline (fall only)
deadlines.notes: Out-of-country tuition waiver worth about $13,000 per year.

deadlines.label: Freshman academic scholarship deadline (fall only)
deadlines.notes: Competitive scores listed: SAT 1300+ or ACT 28; leadership and extracurricular involvement expected.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Non-native English speakers must show proof of English proficiency with TOEFL, IELTS, SAT or ACT scores sent directly by the testing agency. Non-native speakers who attend four years of high school in the United States do not need proof. The page lists only SAT, ACT, TOEFL and IELTS; Duolingo, PTE and Cambridge are not mentioned. No conditional-admission or ESL pathway is described on the international undergraduate page.

english.notes: Listed as 'TOEFL: 69 IBT'; no new 1-6 scale value is given. SAT EBRW 480+ or ACT English/Reading 17+ also satisfies the requirement for first-year students.

cost.notes: International page 'Annual Cost Estimate for Undergraduate Students (2026-2027)': tuition and fees $18,550 (12 credit hours), room and board $11,904, health insurance $2,936, personal expenses (books, supplies, transportation, entertainment) $4,200, total $37,590 (the page labels the total '2024-2025' by mistake). An I-20 requires proof of funds for at least one year of expenses.

aid.notes: International Merit Scholarship (out-of-country tuition waiver) is worth about $13,000 per year, lasts 4 years for freshmen, is competitive, for fall admits only, priority deadline Feb. 1; criteria are good academic standing, financial need and commitment to the university. The page also says Georgia Southern offers a limited number of need-based and academic scholarships for international students. Freshman academic scholarships (Jan. 15) look for SAT 1300+ / ACT 28.

sat.note: The reviewed Georgia Southern pages do not print a numeric SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: The reviewed Georgia Southern pages do not print a numeric ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed; results must be sent directly by the testing service.

ielts.note: No institution code is listed; results must be sent directly by the testing service.
